Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Refactor: modular subfolder structure with reusable modules

Architecture changes:
- Reorganized into subfolders: core/, world/, physics/, materials/, subsystems/, engine/
- All includes now use relative paths \(e.g., "world/world.h"\)

New modules added:
- cell_ops.h: Cell movement, state checks, neighbor iteration
- physics.h: Gravity, velocity, collision response, pressure
- behavior.h: Material behavior flags, state transitions, reactions
- grid_iter.h: Grid traversal patterns with chunk optimization
- utils.h: Shared RNG and hash functions

Refactored subsystems:
- powder.c, fluid.c, fire.c, acid.c, thermal.c now use shared modules
- Eliminated code duplication \(RNG, neighbor arrays, grid iteration\)
- Consistent API for cell operations and physics calculations

Build system:
- Updated Makefile for recursive source file discovery
- Maintains directory structure in build/ folder

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
